source_review.notes: Checked all ten final NASA, FAA, and NIST references on 2026-08-31; every URL returned HTTP 200. Reviewed current NASA method definitions, technical planning, V&V plan, product validation, model/simulation standards record, and handbook; FAA test/evaluation taxonomy and V&V shortcomings report; and NIST measurement-uncertainty guidance. Source-specific terminology is attributed without claiming universal compliance or certification.

evidence: Reviewed requirement-to-observable-to-method-to-data-to-judgment inference chain.
Reviewed upper-limit, measured/predicted result, and uncertainty/allowance notation.
Reviewed finite test-domain observation and analysis-model input/parameter notation.
Reviewed separation of model-form, parameter/input, numerical, and observation uncertainty.
notation_and_syntax.notes: Notation is defined and bounded; illustrative decision rules are not represented as universal standards.

evidence: Executed verification-methods-fixture under python3 with exact output in artifacts/snippets/SYSENG-073/report.json.
Confirmed exact label equality for inspection and 82+2 <= 85 for guarded analysis.
Confirmed all nine synthetic service steps and maximum sampled latency 130 <= 150.
Recomputed Exercise 2 guarded values as 100.3 kPa and 100.7 kPa, neither satisfying the 100.0 kPa upper-limit acceptance rule.
numerical_recomputation.notes: Synthetic central values and allowances do not establish real uncertainty budgets, distributional behavior, model validity, or compliance.

evidence: Confirmed finite samples do not establish an entire continuous or statistical domain without an additional inference argument.
Confirmed an acceptance guard y+U <= L separates central value from uncertainty and may yield inconclusive status.
Confirmed model implementation verification and model validation-for-use address different failure modes.
Confirmed method combination strengthens evidence only when claims and shared assumptions are explicit.
symbolic_recomputation.notes: The chapter provides conditional inference structures and counterexamples, not a universal proof of method adequacy.

evidence: Challenged inaccessible states, proxy observables, subjectivity, tight tolerance, uncertainty overlap, finite tails, dependence, and post hoc thresholds.
Reviewed model form, numerical convergence, invalid domain, similarity differences, common inputs, and false corroboration.
Reviewed human population/training/PPE/workload, expert demonstrations, operational representativeness, and instrumentation intrusion.
Reviewed nominal, envelope corners, transitions, invalid inputs, fault/degraded/recovery, security, destructive, and hazardous cases.
Reviewed invalid runs, rerun bias, test-error hypotheses, waivers, configuration changes, regression, and evidence preservation.
Reviewed all ten examples and five complete answers for assumptions, reasoning, evidence limits, and bounded conclusions.
boundary_and_adversarial_cases.notes: Real claims require relevant domain, requirements, test/analysis, metrology, statistics, model/simulation, human-factors, safety/security, configuration/data, quality, independent review, technical authority, and certification/acceptance expertise.

evidence: Confirmed method selection derives from the requirement, observable, and inference need.
Confirmed every method binds object, baseline, conditions, article, procedure, oracle, uncertainty, data, and limitations.
Confirmed inspection, analysis, demonstration, and test conclusions stay within their evidence ceilings.
Confirmed qualification, verification, validation, acceptance, and certification purposes remain distinct.
Confirmed raw observations, transformations, findings, discrepancies, dispositions, waivers, and authorization remain separable.
Confirmed changes trigger impact analysis rather than automatic evidence carryover.
invariant_checking.notes: No method label, expense, passing sample, model agreement, expert demonstration, heritage identity, rerun, or waiver is presented as sufficient unbounded proof.

proof_review.notes: The chapter includes formal reasoning examples but no theorem proof.

proof_sketch_labeling.notes: No passage is presented as a proof sketch.

evidence: Executable output is labeled synthetic_bounded_method_results_only.
Fixture limitations disclaim inspection competence, model validity, representative humans, latency distribution, configuration, and real compliance.
Official sources are attributed without claiming local verification, validation, certification, or approval.
No external review or real-system method result is claimed.
empirical_evidence_labeling.notes: Synthetic method mechanics, source-backed guidance, internal review, and production assurance remain distinct.

conceptual_review.notes: Internal conceptual review checked method/purpose, inspection, analysis, demonstration, test, oracle, measurement uncertainty, guard band, similarity, triangulation, model V&V, sampling, and claim bounds.

practitioner_review.notes: Internal practitioner-oriented review checked requirement parsing, observable choice, method procedures, model credibility, environments/articles, human representativeness, domain coverage, uncertainty/decision risk, instrumentation, destructive testing, combined methods, anomalies, reports, and change impact.

pedagogical_review.notes: Internal pedagogical review confirmed progression from method taxonomy to inference design and evidence governance. Ten distinct examples and five complete solutions cover physical, software, service, data, formal, statistical, human, supplier, and anomaly cases.

limitations: Internal evidence record only; no external NASA/FAA/NIST expert, regulator, customer, requirements owner, inspection/test engineer, metrologist, statistician, model/simulation specialist, human-factors specialist, safety/security engineer, configuration/data/quality authority, independent V&V reviewer, technical authority, acceptance authority, or certification body review is claimed.
